fusions.name: Chill Ripple
fusions.desc: A chilling ripple that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Deepfreeze Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of ice that deals 32 damage, ignoring the target's resistances. The target is [Frozen] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Pool
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and your allies for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Blood
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 10%.
